seo.title: AI Skin Check | Personalized Skincare Routine
seo.description: Find a skincare direction using photo quality and a short questionnaire.

title: 30-second skin check
subtitle: We combine photo conditions with how your skin feels day to day to suggest a practical care direction.
medicalNotice: This result is cosmetic guidance only and does not replace medical diagnosis or treatment.

photo.title: Start with a face photo
photo.description: Take a front-facing photo in soft, even light for a more consistent result.

tips.light: Even light across the whole face
tips.front: Look straight ahead with a neutral expression
tips.filter: No filters, beauty mode, or heavy makeup

photo.privacy: Your photo is checked only in browser memory and is never uploaded or stored.

quality.good: Photo conditions look good. Continue to the questions.
quality.dark: The photo is too dark. Retake it in a brighter place.
quality.bright: The photo is too bright. Avoid harsh direct light.
quality.flat: Contrast is too low. Retake with soft front lighting.

vision.loading: Analyzing facial regions on your device…
vision.ready: Face and skin regions found. Continue to the questions.
vision.noFace: No face found. Use a photo showing the full face.
vision.multipleFaces: Use a photo containing one person only.
vision.pose: Face the camera directly and move a little closer.
vision.failed: Photo analysis failed. Please try another photo.

concern.title: What is your main skin concern?

feel.title: How does skin feel after cleansing?

sensitive.title: Does skin react to new products?
sensitive.hint: Think of stinging, itching, or redness.

budget.title: What matters when choosing products?
budget.hint: This will shape future product matching.

result.title: Your personal guide is ready
result.disclaimer: Cosmetic guidance combining MediaPipe face analysis with questionnaire answers.
result.visualNotice: Scores are experimental comparisons of color and brightness within this photo. They do not measure moisture, disease, or physiological condition.
result.tagNotice: Once skincare products have ingredient and benefit tags, the system will automatically select three matching products.

cleanse.title: Gentle cleanse
cleanse.body: A low-irritation cleanser that respects the barrier

treat.title: Focused care
treat.body: Start with one ingredient for your main concern

protect.title: Moisturize and protect
protect.body: Finish with moisturizer and wear SPF by day

sensitive.title: Sensitivity-prone
sensitive.body: Start slowly with gentle, low-fragrance products instead of adding several actives at once.

oily.title: Oil-prone
oily.body: Avoid over-cleansing and use lightweight hydration with non-clogging textures.

combination.title: Combination
combination.body: Adjust moisturizer by area for an oilier T-zone and drier cheeks.

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.body: Maintain your current balance and focus a simple routine on one concern.

blemish.title: Blemishes
blemish.body: Consider low-strength salicylic acid or niacinamide and stop if irritation occurs.

pigment.title: Spots and dullness
pigment.body: Consider vitamin C or niacinamide with daily sunscreen.

redness.title: Redness and comfort
redness.body: Prioritize gentle barrier-supporting ingredients such as panthenol, centella, and ceramides.

pores.title: Pores and texture
pores.body: Pair gentle exfoliation with hydration and avoid harsh scrubs.

dryness.title: Dryness and tightness
dryness.body: A routine with glycerin, hyaluronic acid, and ceramides may suit you.
